title: NeMo Anonymizer observability sanitizer worker
description: Sanitizes copied NeMo Relay observability values before normal subscriber and exporter fan-out.

priority.description: Relay middleware priority. Lower values run first.

max_text_leaves.description: Maximum number of text values and mapping keys inspected per sanitizer invocation.

max_text_bytes.description: Maximum aggregate UTF-8 bytes inspected per sanitizer invocation.

max_text_leaf_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes accepted in one selected text value or key. Must not exceed max_text_bytes.

detector_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the Anonymizer entity detector.

detector_api_key_env.description: Environment name installed through secret_env, or EMPTY for a local unauthenticated detector.

evaluator_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for validation and augmentation.

evaluator_api_key_env.description: Environment name containing the evaluator credential.

entity_labels.description: Explicit Anonymizer label allowlist. Supplying a list keeps detection strict instead of enabling Anonymizer's full default catalog and permissive augmentation.

excluded_entity_labels.description: Labels removed from entity_labels before detection. Exclusions cannot remove the entire allowlist.

provider_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout passed to each Anonymizer provider call. Relay applies a separate host callback deadline: compatible 0.9.x hosts use a fixed 30-second deadline, while current Relay supports manifest defaults and per-callback overrides.

data_summary.description: Optional context supplied to Anonymizer detection.
data_summary.default: Copied AI-agent observability containing prompts, model responses, and tool traffic.

secret_env.description: Literal environment values made available only inside the managed worker. Relay does not resolve secret references; protect the plugin configuration file.
